annealed_positive_closure.statement: For fresh W_ji~N(0,2/d), ReLU(W h)|h depends on h only through r=||h||. Radius is an exact one-dimensional Markov sufficient state when future Gaussian weights are also averaged over.

quenched_obstruction.statement: For fixed invertible square W, on the open cone W^T h>0 the ReLU layer equals W^T h and has Jacobian rank n. Any C1 exact factorization through T:R^n->R^k has Jacobian rank <=k, so k>=n.
quenched_obstruction.scope: full next activation vector; C1 statistics; fixed realized full-rank square layer
does_not_rule_out: statistics for one special scalar observable

new_class.name: annealed radial plug-in after exact realized prefix
new_class.description: Keep realized network exact through layer s, then replace only future fixed dense layers by the exact fresh-weight annealed scalar radial law.
new_class.strongest_late_test: start_layer=3; first three realized layers exact; only final layer annealed

interpretation.verdict: There is an exact scalar sufficient state only in the annealed fresh-weight law. Conditioning on the realized dense white-box weights destroys any exact C1 dimension-reducing closure for the full activation vector. The one new class tested after this obstruction—exact-prefix plus annealed radial future—fails by ~4.27e7 times the raw target even when only the final layer is annealed.
interpretation.primary_blocker: quenched directional information is irreducible at full rank; radial averaging discards it
interpretation.production_cost: UNEXECUTED because the frozen small exact scientific gate failed; no production prototype authorized
interpretation.successor_constraint: A successor must leave the exact low-dimensional C1 full-vector closure class and the fresh-weight radial plug-in class. It must preserve quenched directional information without explicit 2^n mask state and without reopening E111/E112.

receipt_policy: immutable terminal receipt; no E113 rerun or post-result statistic augmentation
